articles.summary: Pedro Villa, Roseville Service Unit locomotive engineer and Air Force Reserve electrical superintendent, was publically honored for receiving a Purple Heart during a Sacramento Kings' basketball game on Military Appreciation Night, Nov. 9.
articles.title: Union Pacific Engineer Honored With Purple Heart

articles.summary: Dozens of Red Cross emergency response vehicles used in Hurricane Sandy recovery were returned to their native locations, thanks to Union Pacific.
articles.title: Emergency Vehicles Delivered Home After Sandy

articles.summary: Union Pacific transferred control of the MKT Bridge to the City of Boonville, Mo., during a Jan. 8 ceremony.
articles.title: UP Gives Historic Bridge to Boonville, Missouri

articles.summary: The Union Pacific Railroad Museum partnered with members of UP's Black Employee Network (BEN) in February to celebrate Black History Month, offering a new in-school educational program and guided museum tours.
articles.title: Employee Group Leads Museum Tours During Black History Month

articles.summary: Union Pacific's communities continue benefitting from cooperation between the railroad and various emergency response organizations, with a goal of preventing and preparing for hazardous materials incidents.
articles.title: UP Builds Responders' Rail Safety Awareness

articles.summary: A book written by UP's Deb Ashworth and her daughter aims to teach young Nebraskans not only about the Cornhusker State's rich history, but also railroad safety.
articles.title: UP Dispatching Director's Book Teaches Rail Safety

articles.summary: Union Pacific recently contributed $80,000, distributed in $10,000 increments, to eight food banks in its northern region states to purchase 1.6 million pounds of food, or enough to fill eight boxcars.
articles.title: Union Pacific Contributes to Northern Region Food Banks

articles.summary: Each year, the North Platte Telegraph salutes Bailey Yard and its ties to the community with its supplement, "Railroad Ties."
articles.title: A Salute to North Platte and to UP's Bailey Yard

articles.summary: Union Pacific donated $500,000 toward the Nebraska Centennial Mall revitalization project during a ceremony held at the State Capitol Rotunda March 1 – Nebraska's Statehood Day.
articles.title: Donation Helps Fund Centennial Mall Revitalization

articles.summary: Today we launched our new Community Ties website. The site contains news, photos and videos about Union Pacific, its employees and the communities where we live and work.
articles.title:
Welcome to
Community Ties

articles.summary: The reception for the traveling exhibit was a fun night out for volunteers.
articles.title: Alcatraz Comes to Yuma, and UP Helps with the Prison Break

articles.summary: Special agents from Union Pacific and BNSF teamed up to build a shadow box for a terminally ill, 7-year-old boy in Rustburg, Virginia, responding to his final wish to receive holiday cards from law enforcement officers, firefighters and paramedics.
articles.title: Special Agents Craft Shadow Box for Ill Child

articles.summary: When the Track Renewal Train (TRT 909) and other large track gangs roll through major cities, the attention of several UP departments is needed to keep employees and the public safe, reduce traffic congestion and enhance the railroad's reputation as a good neighbor.
articles.title: TRT Rolls Smoothly Through Arlington
